Name: Elle's Cuter Grass
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1775954086-1833789386.png[/img]﻿
[Alt text: A banner with text that reads "Features"]

- This is a content pack for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]mushymato[/url]'s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36458]Grass Variety[/url]
- Adds many new grass sprites
﻿- 9 sprites in 5 colors of normal grass per season
﻿- 9 sprites in 3 colors of blue grass per season
﻿- 6 different flower types to mix and match
- Adds an option for shorter grass
- Optional version to match DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]
- Optional version to match grapeponta's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1775954086-671416052.png[/img]﻿
[Alt text: A banner with text that reads "How to Install:"]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36458]Grass Variety[/url].
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract this mod into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[b][color=#e69138]5[/color][/b]. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the images in the References folder to add the "Flower Grass" you want, as well as the "Grass Length" ("tall" or "short"). Multiple flower options are allowed, separated by commas. If you can't get a config.json to generate, you can rename the example_config.json to config.json and use it instead. By default all flowers are enabled and the "Grass Length" is set to "tall."
[b][color=#e69138]6[/color][/b]. Run the game using SMAPI to play with your new grass!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1775954086-1128123912.png[/img]
